_comment: Single source of truth for V&V standards coverage. Consumed by tests/vv/test_registry.py (CI status table + pinned issue #67) and scripts/gen_standards_report.py (GitHub Pages dashboard). Each test's declared status is the INTENT; for pytest-backed rows the live JUnit result overrides it. status: covered | xfail | skip | pending | notebook | test-local. test-local marks a row whose test asserts logic implemented in the test file (an adapter, a choice model or an input check), not simulator output; its note says what is verified. 'test' joins to a pytest testcase by 'ClassPrefix' or 'ClassPrefix::method_name'.

standards.name: IMO MSC.1/Circ.1533
standards.full_name: Revised Guidelines for Evacuation Analysis for New and Existing Passenger Ships

tests.name: Walking speed in a corridor
tests.criterion: Evacuation time ~ d/v +/- 20%

tests.name: Walking speed up stairs
tests.criterion: 1 m/s on a 10 m stair (along the incline) gives 10 s (+/- 0.5 s)
tests.note: The stair is a flat speed-factor zone; the desired speed is set so that v0 * factor = 1 m/s. Up and down use the same mechanism, so direction is not modelled.

tests.name: Walking speed down stairs
tests.criterion: 1 m/s on a 10 m stair (along the incline) gives 10 s (+/- 0.5 s)
tests.note: The stair is a flat speed-factor zone; the desired speed is set so that v0 * factor = 1 m/s. Up and down use the same mechanism, so direction is not modelled.

tests.name: Exit flow rate
tests.criterion: Flow (N-1)/(t_last-t_first) through a 1 m exit <= 1.33 p/s with the exit throughput limiter enabled
tests.note: Limiter enabled at 1.33 p/s (maintainer decision D12); measured 1.31 p/s on seed 42, tolerance 1%. The emergent flow with the limiter off (~5.8 p/s) is printed by the test, not asserted. The exit is a 1 x 1 m absorbing square inside the room, not a wall opening (known, unchanged).

tests.name: Response time
tests.criterion: Agents respect an assigned pre-movement distribution

tests.name: Rounding corners
tests.criterion: Navigate a 90-degree corner; agent bodies stay inside the geometry (centre at least radius - 1 mm from walls)

tests.name: Assignment of population demographics
tests.criterion: All agents evacuate within [25 s, 120 s]

tests.name: Counterflow
tests.criterion: Counterflow increases evacuation time

tests.name: Exit-count sensitivity
tests.criterion: Halving the exits increases evacuation time

tests.name: Exit route allocation
tests.criterion: Agents use assigned escape routes

tests.name: Congestion / flow on stairs
tests.criterion: Baseline 1D speed-density samples at least 75% inside the reference 10/90 band; slower run has lower mean speed than baseline; faster run at least 75% above the 90th percentile
tests.note: The test runs the RiMEA 16 ring speed-density check. The IMO Test 11 staircase scenario (room, corridor, stair; congestion at the room exit and at the stair base) is not implemented.

tests.name: Flow-density relation
tests.criterion: Not implemented
tests.note: IMO MSC.1/Circ.1533 Annex 3 lists this test; there is no test for it in this suite.

standards.name: RiMEA 4.1.1
standards.full_name: Guideline for Microscopic Evacuation Analysis (RiMEA), section 4.1.1 verification tests

tests.name: Speed in a corridor
tests.criterion: Travel time at 1.33 m/s in [26, 34] s

tests.name: Speed up stairs
tests.criterion: Walking speed maintained upstairs

tests.name: Speed down stairs
tests.criterion: Walking speed maintained downstairs

tests.name: Fundamental diagram
tests.criterion: Local density increases with population and walking speed does not increase with density

tests.name: Pre-movement time
tests.criterion: Agents respect assigned pre-movement delay

tests.name: Corner movement
tests.criterion: Navigate a corner; agent bodies do not overlap a wall (centre at least radius - 1 mm from walls)

tests.name: Demographic parameters
tests.criterion: Speed distribution matches the age-based table

tests.name: Parameter study
tests.criterion: Evacuation time varies with parameters

tests.name: Large public space
tests.criterion: Closing 2/4 exits increases evacuation time

tests.name: Route allocation
tests.criterion: Agents use assigned escape routes

tests.name: Escape route choice
tests.criterion: Agents prefer the closer exit while some use the alternative exit
tests.note: Exit choice is drawn once by a stochastic distance-based model implemented in the test file; the test verifies that model split, not simulator route choice.

tests.name: Goal position
tests.criterion: Room-1 clearance time (last occupant leaves room 1) increases with goal distance a and levels off

tests.name: Bottleneck length
tests.criterion: Room-1 clearance time (last occupant leaves room 1) is larger for a 5 m bottleneck than for a 0.2 m door

tests.name: Congestion influence
tests.criterion: Measure congestion influence at bottlenecks
tests.note: RiMEA 4.1.1 sets no pass criterion for this test; it asks for N(t) per room and the flow per bottleneck to be documented. The assertion is the suite's own.

tests.name: Bottleneck width
tests.criterion: Wider bottleneck yields faster evacuation

tests.name: Fundamental diagram on stairs
tests.criterion: Down-stair speed > up-stair speed
tests.note: Deviates from RiMEA 4.1.1, which wants stair speeds within the Abb. 16 spread: the test only requires at least 25% of the points inside the coded Corbetta band and publishes the inside-band fraction per direction (up 0.95, down 0.70). The band (Corbetta coefficients vs RiMEA Abb. 16) and the RiMEA standard population (section 3.2.4) are not yet checked.

tests.name: Route choice
tests.criterion: Document short vs long route preference
tests.note: RiMEA 4.1.1 asks for the route-choice behaviour to be documented. The test shows that agents follow configured waypoints (RiMEA answer: configurable). The scenario is single-level, with no stairs or floors.

tests.name: Large crowd around a corner
tests.criterion: Corner slows evacuation vs a straight path

tests.name: 1D fundamental diagram
tests.criterion: Speed-density sweep from free flow to congestion compared with the 10/90 percentile band
tests.note: RiMEA 4.1.1 asks to show the parameter influence and sets no pass limit. The test sweeps 5 to 45 agents on the ring (about 0.2 to 1.7 1/m) and requires non-increasing mean speed, no overtaking and at least 75% of binned speeds inside the band; the 0.8 m wide lane is not single-file by geometry, so order changes are checked.

standards.name: NIST TN 1822
standards.full_name: The Process of Verification and Validation of Building Fire Evacuation Models (Ronchi et al., 2013)

tests.name: Pre-evacuation time distributions
tests.criterion: KS p > 0.05 for uniform/gamma/lognormal/weibull

tests.name: Speed in a corridor
tests.criterion: Walking speed 1.0 +/- 0.05 m/s over the 40 m segment

tests.name: Speed on stairs (up)
tests.criterion: Stair speed 1.0 +/- 0.05 m/s upward over 100 m
tests.note: The scenario is a flat corridor with no stair element, so this checks corridor walking speed over 100 m, as Verif.2.1 does, not movement on stairs.

tests.name: Speed on stairs (down)
tests.criterion: Stair speed 1.0 +/- 0.05 m/s downward over 100 m
tests.note: The scenario is a flat corridor with no stair element, so this checks corridor walking speed over 100 m, as Verif.2.1 does, not movement on stairs.

tests.name: Movement around a corner
tests.criterion: All 20 agents evacuate; agent bodies do not overlap the boundary (centre at least radius - 1 mm inside)

tests.name: Assigned demographics
tests.criterion: Gaussian(1.2, 0.2) desired-speed distribution configured
tests.note: The test reads the scenario file and checks the configured Gaussian(1.2, 0.2) speed distribution; it samples no agent and runs no simulation.

tests.name: Reduced visibility vs walking speed
tests.criterion: At K_s = 1/m, simulated 100 m travel time matches the declared Equation 2 smoke-speed correlation
tests.note: The smoke speed factor is applied by a test-local adapter using a declared correlation; the test checks travel time against that declared factor, not the correlation itself.

tests.name: Agent incapacitation (FED)
tests.criterion: Timestep-integrated FDS+Evac FED reaches 1 within one timestep of the independent constant-hazard calculation
tests.note: FED is accumulated by a test-local adapter on each timestep (JuPedSim has no native FED model); the test checks the adapter against a hand calculation.

tests.name: Elevator usage
tests.criterion: Agents evacuate via elevator
tests.note: Needs an elevator component.

tests.name: Horizontal counter-flows
tests.criterion: Last room-1 occupant's room-2 entry time increases strictly with counterflow; blocked levels are documented and count as later than any finite level
tests.note: Seed 42: 0 -> 46.6 s, 10 -> 70.0 s; counterflow 50 and 100 block (not all room-1 occupants enter room 2), blocking documented per the protocol.

tests.name: Group behaviours
tests.criterion: Group 1 arrival spread <= 10 s
tests.note: CollisionFreeSpeedModel has no group-cohesion model (spread ~24 s).

tests.name: Agents with movement disabilities
tests.criterion: Zone-1 occupants exit later (last and mean exit time) when a slower, larger occupant is present
tests.note: 2 m ramp (TN 1822 Fig. 7). Scenario built by standards/utils/movement_disability.py. The disabled occupant's ramp speed (0.4 m/s) is set every step in that builder, because jupedsim-scenarios 0.7.3 applies speed zones to every agent; the zone-1 delay is simulator output.

tests.name: Exit route allocation
tests.criterion: Each of 23 agents reaches its allocated exit

tests.name: Social influence
tests.criterion: Exit choice shifts under social influence
tests.note: CollisionFreeSpeedModel has no social-influence model; exit-2 usage is unchanged.

tests.name: Affiliation
tests.criterion: Agents prefer familiar exits
tests.note: Affiliation is represented by journey weights set in the input; the test checks that exit choice responds to those weights, not an affiliation model.

tests.name: Dynamic availability of exits
tests.criterion: Agents reroute when an exit closes at runtime
tests.note: Not run (pytest marker run=False). The public API cannot make an exit unavailable at runtime (jupedsim-scenarios 0.7.3, the locked version, removes exits only before a run and has no runtime exit closure); the test forces the reroute through private runner state and is not run.

tests.name: Congestion
tests.criterion: Peak density at the room exit > downstream corridor window

tests.name: Maximum flow rates
tests.criterion: Specific flow <= 1.33 p/m/s with the exit throughput limiter enabled (IMO)
tests.note: Verified with the jupedsim-scenarios exit throughput limiter enabled at 1.33 p/s (maintainer decision D12, restricted-flow reading); measured 1.31 p/m/s on seed 42. Flow is (N-1)/(t_last-t_first) over agent removal times, tolerance 1% for trajectory sampling. The emergent flow with the limiter off (~5.2 p/m/s) is reported in the notebook, not asserted.

standards.name: ISO 20414:2020
standards.full_name: Fire safety engineering - Verification and validation protocol for building fire evacuation models

tests.name: Pre-evacuation time assignment
tests.criterion: Start times fit the assigned distribution (two-sample KS, alpha=0.05)

tests.name: Walking speed in a corridor
tests.criterion: Walking speed 1.0 +/- 0.05 m/s over the 40 m segment

tests.name: Walking speed on stairs
tests.criterion: 1 m/s on the 10 m stair gives 10 s: stair speed 1.0 +/- 0.05 m/s
tests.note: The stair is a flat speed-factor zone (0.5); the desired speed is 2.0 m/s so that the speed on the stair is 1 m/s. Up and down use the same mechanism.

tests.name: Movement around a corner
tests.criterion: All agents evacuate; agent bodies do not overlap the boundary (centre at least radius - 1 mm inside)

tests.name: Assigned occupant demographics
tests.criterion: Realized speeds match Gaussian(1.2, 0.2) (pooled mean/std + KS)

tests.name: Horizontal counter-flows
tests.criterion: Last room-1 occupant's room-2 entry time increases strictly with counterflow; blocked levels are documented and count as later than any finite level
tests.note: Seed 42: 0 -> 46.6 s, 10 -> 70.0 s; counterflow 50 and 100 block (no lane formation in CollisionFreeSpeedModel), blocking documented per ISO 20414.

tests.name: Overtaking people with movement disabilities
tests.criterion: Zone-1 occupants exit later (last and mean exit time) when a slower, larger occupant is present
tests.note: 12 m ramp (ISO 20414 Fig. 4). Scenario built by standards/utils/movement_disability.py. The disabled occupant's ramp speed (0.4 m/s) is set every step in that builder, because jupedsim-scenarios 0.7.3 applies speed zones to every agent; the zone-1 delay is simulator output.

tests.name: Exit route allocation
tests.criterion: Every agent reaches its allocated exit
tests.note: ISO 20414 is inconsistent: Table 9 says 23 agents, Figure 5 shows 13 (1 person per room, 2 in room 3). The suite follows the text (23 agents: 2 per room, 1 in room 3), as RiMEA, NIST and IMO specify.

tests.name: Dynamic availability of exits
tests.criterion: An occupant reroutes when its initially selected exit becomes unavailable
tests.note: Not run (pytest marker run=False). The public API cannot make an exit unavailable at runtime (jupedsim-scenarios 0.7.3, the locked version, removes exits only before a run and has no runtime exit closure); the test forces the reroute through private runner state and is not run.

tests.name: Congestion in front of a stair
tests.criterion: Peak density at the room->neck entrance and stair base exceeds the mid-corridor

tests.name: Maximum flow rates at an exit
tests.criterion: Specific flow <= 1.33 p/m/s with the exit throughput limiter enabled (IMO)
tests.note: Verified with the jupedsim-scenarios exit throughput limiter enabled at 1.33 p/s (maintainer decision D12, restricted-flow reading); measured 1.31 p/m/s on seed 42. Flow is (N-1)/(t_last-t_first) over agent removal times, tolerance 1% for trajectory sampling. The emergent flow with the limiter off (~5.2 p/m/s) is reported in the notebook, not asserted.

tests.name: Stair flow rates
tests.criterion: Flow rate increases with stair width (positive slope)

tests.name: Flow, density and speed in a corridor
tests.criterion: Zone-2 speed stays within the assigned free speed

tests.name: Group behaviour
tests.criterion: The homogeneous fast group reaches the exit together (spread <= 10 s)

tests.name: Social influence on exit choice
tests.criterion: A deterministic exit-2 occupant raises free occupants' exit-2 usage
tests.note: CollisionFreeSpeedModel has no social-influence model; exit-2 usage is unchanged.

tests.name: Affiliation to familiar exits
tests.criterion: Journey-weighted affiliation biases exit choice (80/20 -> exit 2 preferred)
tests.note: The outcome is fixed by the input journey weights and the harness's proportional split of agents over journeys, not by an affiliation model; same mechanism as NIST Verif.3.3.

tests.name: Route choice from geometric layout
tests.criterion: Agents prefer the geometrically shorter route

tests.name: Reduced visibility vs walking speed
tests.criterion: Not implemented
tests.note: ISO 20414 Table 20 lists this test; there is no test for it in this suite.

tests.name: Occupant incapacitation by fire/smoke
tests.criterion: Not implemented
tests.note: ISO 20414 Table 20 lists this test; there is no test for it in this suite.

tests.name: Lift usage
tests.criterion: Not implemented
tests.note: ISO 20414 Table 20 lists this test; there is no test for it in this suite.

tests.name: Escalator usage
tests.criterion: Not implemented
tests.note: ISO 20414 Table 20 lists this test; there is no test for it in this suite.
